'''''Euphorbia piscatoria''''', the '''fish-stunning spurge''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[spurge]] family [[Euphorbiaceae]]. It is endemic to the [[Madeira]] archipelago.<ref name="iucn status"></ref> This species is a shrubby succulent. As most other succulent members of the genus ''Euphorbia'', its trade is regulated under Appendix II of [[CITES]].<ref name="Species+">{{Cite web |title=Species+|url=https://speciesplus.net/species#/taxon_concepts/21484/legal |access-date=7 February 2023}}</ref>
